description: This file defines the primary view model class `NodeAppModel` for an iOS app managing device capabilities, gateway communication, handling deep links, notifications, camera interactions, and various system services. It includes methods for controlling background activity, connecting to gateways, handling various invoke commands (e.g., canvas, camera, notifications), and managing app state.

classes.name: NodeAppModel
classes.description: Main observable class managing app state, gateway connections, system services, and command handling for an iOS app.

methods.name: setScenePhase
methods.description: Handles app scene phase changes, managing background/foreground transitions, connectivity, and background activity.

methods.name: beginBackgroundConnectionGracePeriod
methods.description: Starts a grace period to maintain gateway connection when app moves to background.

methods.name: endBackgroundConnectionGracePeriod
methods.description: Ends the background connection grace period.

methods.name: grantBackgroundReconnectLease
methods.description: Provides a lease duration to keep background reconnection attempts active.

methods.name: suppressBackgroundReconnect
methods.description: Suppresses background reconnection and optionally disconnects from gateways.

methods.name: clearBackgroundReconnectSuppression
methods.description: Clears suppression of background reconnection logic.

methods.name: setVoiceWakeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables voice wake functionality.

methods.name: setTalkEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode, updating related system states and gateway.

methods.name: requestLocationPermissions
methods.description: Requests location permissions based on specified mode.

methods.name: refreshBrandingFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches branding configuration from the gateway and updates UI theme and session keys.

methods.name: refreshAgentsFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches list of agents from the gateway.

methods.name: refreshGatewayOverviewIfConnected
methods.description: Refreshes branding and agents if the gateway connection is active.

methods.name: setSelectedAgentId
methods.description: Sets the current agent ID and updates relevant gateway state and persistent storage.

methods.name: setGlobalWakeWords
methods.description: Sets wake words for voice activation in the gateway.

methods.name: startVoiceWakeSync
methods.description: Initiates synchronization of voice wake words from gateway.

methods.name: applyTalkModeSync
methods.description: Updates local talk mode state based on gateway push event.

methods.name: pushTalkModeToGateway
methods.description: Updates the gateway with the current talk mode state.

methods.name: startGatewayHealthMonitor
methods.description: Starts periodic health checks for gateway connection.

methods.name: stopGatewayHealthMonitor
methods.description: Stops the gateway health check process.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Handles generic invocation requests; routes to specific handlers based on command.

methods.name: handleCanvasInvoke
methods.description: Processes commands related to canvas operations like presenting, hiding, navigating, evaluating JS, and snapshot.

methods.name: handleCameraInvoke
methods.description: Processes camera commands such as listing devices, taking snapshots, recording clips.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify
methods.description: Handles system notification requests and shows local notifications.

methods.name: runNotificationCall
methods.description: Executes notification-related asynchronous operations with a timeout.

methods.name: handleDeviceInvoke
methods.description: Processes device info and status requests.

methods.name: refreshWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches wake words from the gateway, decodes triggers, and saves them, with error handling for unauthorized access.

methods.name: sendVoiceTranscript
methods.description: Sends a voice transcript text to the gateway as an event, with checks for connection status and payload encoding.

methods.name: handleDeepLink
methods.description: Processes a deep link URL by parsing it into a route and handling agent or gateway links.

methods.name: handleAgentDeepLink
methods.description: Handles agent deep links by validating message size, gateway connectivity, and authorization, including rate-limited prompts and user confirmation.

methods.name: sendAgentRequest
methods.description: Encodes and sends an agent deep link request event to the gateway.

methods.name: isGatewayConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the gateway is currently connected.

methods.name: applyMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the main session key if different from the current one.

methods.name: color(fromHex:)
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to a Color object.

methods.name: approvePendingAgentDeepLinkPrompt
methods.description: Approves and submits a pending agent deep link prompt if present and connected.

methods.name: declinePendingAgentDeepLinkPrompt
methods.description: Declines and clears a pending agent deep link prompt.

methods.name: presentAgentDeepLinkPrompt
methods.description: Displays an agent deep link prompt and updates the timestamp for rate limiting.

methods.name: queueAgentDeepLinkPrompt
methods.description: Queues a deep link prompt to be delivered after a delay, with a task managing the delayed delivery.

methods.name: deliverQueuedAgentDeepLinkPrompt
methods.description: Delivers queued prompts based on timing and rate limiting, presenting the prompt when appropriate.

methods.name: submitAgentDeepLink
methods.description: Sends an agent deep link request to the gateway and logs success or failure.

methods.name: effectiveAgentDeepLinkForPrompt
methods.description: Reduces exposure of sensitive delivery info for untrusted links by stripping certain fields.

methods.name: isUnattendedDeepLinkAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a deep link key permits unattended operation based on predefined allowed keys.

methods.name: expectedDeepLinkKey
methods.description: Retrieves or generates a stored deep link authorization key.

methods.name: generateDeepLinkKey
methods.description: Generates a secure random base64-encoded key for deep link authorization.
